  Deck toolkit for AI harnesses: your runes, deployed.
  {VERSION} ({COMMIT}) built {TIME}

  Flow:
    init        <SLUG_OR_DIR> [--lang <LANG>] [--purpose <PURPOSE>]   Scaffold a project from a skeleton
    quest       [SLUG_OR_PATH]                                        Bind or show the working repository
    add         <ID[,ID...]>                                          Add runes to the consumer manifest
    tui         [--source <DIR>] [--edit]                             Launch the terminal dashboard
    dashboard   [--source <DIR>] [--port <PORT>]                      Launch the read-only web dashboard
    install     [--source <DIR>] [--target <DIR>]                     Assemble and deploy module content
    review      <COMMAND>                                             Inspect or export TUI review comments

  Deck:
    validate    [--source <DIR>]                                      Validate module files against schemas
    drift       [--source <DIR>] [--upstream <DIR> | --target <DIR>]  Compare source, build, and deployment drift
    provenance  [--target <DIR_OR_FILE>]                              Show deployed-file provenance
    clean       [--source <DIR>] [--target <DIR>]                     Remove stale installed files
    release     [DOMAIN] [--source <DIR>]                             Package module release tarballs
    adopt       <URL> [--module <DIR>]                                Adopt an upstream artifact with provenance
    watch       <COMMAND>                                             Manage monitored module locations

  Plumbing:
    assemble    [--source <DIR>]                                      Assemble module content into build/
    deploy      [--source <DIR>] [--target <DIR>]                     Deploy assembled provider files
    copy        --source <DIR> --target <DIR>                         Copy source files without transforms
    config      [set <KEY> <VALUE>]                                   Show or update resolved configuration
    find        <QUERY>                                               Find local artifacts by relevance
    exec        <SKILL> [-- ARGS...]                                  Run a script bundled with a skill
    launch      <TOOL> [-- ARGS...]                                   Launch a coding tool with middleware

  Quick start:
    rune init N4M3Z/demo --lang rust --purpose tool
    rune quest N4M3Z/demo
    rune add development
    rune tui --edit
    rune install

  rune <command> --help for flags and details
